assets.prompt: Use case: lighting-weather. EDIT the supplied original LGE documentary installation photograph. It must still look recognizably like the exact same photo, from the same camera in the same moment, with its original horizontal roughly 4:3 framing. Only apply extremely light photographic development, as a photo editor would do: softly lift deep shadows on the brown shutters, temper brightest glare on the plaster, and make the overall daylight white balance slightly more neutral. Keep the paint finish very close to the existing warm brown. Preserve exactly the shutter frames, shape, horizontal slat count/spacing, all hinges and their position, the silver handle, locking hardware and keys, fitting and original finish, door/window glass and reflections, facade, air conditioning unit, green railing, and the physical background. Keep the camera perspective and all objects. Do not reconstruct, recolor, replace, reframe, add or remove any objects, hardware or architectural elements. No new light sources, no blur, no dramatic grading, no logos, no added text. This should read as the same real installation with a barely visible correction of light, not a newly generated image. One photo.
